The independent parts of what is left after some decisions

Source: R/configuration.R
vp_split_after.Rd

What is left to decide after some decisions, and how it splits: the independent parts of the features that the decisions do not settle. A few decisions taken first, together, can cut a model that is one piece into parts that teams can then decide apart.

Usage

vp_split_after(model, selected = character(0), deselected = character(0))

Arguments

model

A model, from vp_generate() or vp_read(), in its complete or its minimal form.

selected, deselected

The decisions taken first (as in vp_consequences()).

Value

A tibble with part, size and feature (as vp_independent_parts()) over the undecided features; its attribute "decided" lists the features the decisions settle.

See also

Other configuration: vp_can_go_together(), vp_consequences(), vp_count_graph_products(), vp_kernel(), vp_kernel_links(), vp_mig(), vp_most_decisive(), vp_pair(), vp_partial_configuration(), vp_rounds(), vp_splitting_decisions(), vp_team_links(), vp_team_moves(), vp_team_order(), vp_teams()

Examples

band <- vp_generate(vp_example("miband3.uvl"), or_graph = TRUE)
vp_split_after(band, selected = "BT40")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>    part  size feature        
#>   <int> <int> <chr>          
#> 1     1     1 HeartRateSensor
